items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Did they have a good drummer... Who was playing drums? Baby Dot.

ctx.x: Did they have a good drummer, a good banjo player, a guitar player? Who was playing drums?
Baby Dot. Oh yeah. You remember Baby Dot went to Chicago, he died there not long ago. Yes.

Oh yeah. Let's see. Did you know that nasty talking guitar player? Who? That nasty talking guitar player, Lorenzo Stahl. Did you know him, the one who would sing all the dirty songs? No. I thought he played with Eagle for a while.
